name: SIQ - Collection Circle Reveal
description: A scroll-driven section where a bold colored background shrinks into a circle at the bottom, revealing product image circles from a single collection that fan out behind it. Features a spinning text badge, heading, sub-heading, and description. On mobile it shows a static layout with horizontally scrollable product circles. Supports custom spinning text, background color, badge size, and full typography control.
author: SectionIQ
